info.title: Niu Console & Saved Session API
info.description:
Model inference and management APIs for Niu. Browse the resource groups in the sidebar,
search by operation or path, and expand the request and response schemas for exact fields.

## Getting started
Use the [HTTP quickstart](/help/guides/api-quickstart/) for your first model request,
or the [JavaScript SDK guide](/help/guides/sdk-quickstart/) for typed clients.
[Download the complete OpenAPI 3.1 document](/docs/openapi/public.json).

## Authentication and scope
Inference uses a workspace API key. Management operations require the member session,
platform authority or Provider membership stated by that operation. These credentials
are not interchangeable. See each operation's security scheme and access description.
Legacy `project` path segments refer to workspaces; legacy `provider` paths refer to Providers.

## Requests and responses
Send the documented Content-Type and use the declared request schema. Response status codes,
error bodies and pagination fields are operation-specific. Follow the returned cursor rather
than assuming a list is complete. Streaming operations document their event format separately.

Monetary amounts and large counters use the exact string representation in their schemas.
Preserve currency and rate units; Provider purchase rates and customer charges are separate.

## Writes and retries
Where an operation documents an idempotency key, retry an uncertain outcome with the same
key and identical input. Preserve expected revisions for configuration updates; reload after
a conflict. A timeout does not prove that a write or an upstream generation did not execute.
Read the individual operation's retry and reconciliation behavior before resubmitting.

get.summary: List the current actor video intent index
get.description: Actor-owned workspace records: installation authority shares one installation actor, while operator actors are isolated even within the same workspace. Current workspace permission applies. Request content is retained for 30 days from creation or until deletion; expiry is unreadable immediately and background maintenance clears retained content. Identity tombstones remain. Deletion does not cancel an already accepted concurrent submission, erase its job or refund charges. Newest-first creation order with UUID tie-breaker. The index contains only intent identity, revision, expiry and retention state; it intentionally exposes no request, model or key content. Index access remains available for deleting retained content after key revocation. Read each intent separately under current key authorization. A cursor must belong to this actor and workspace. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.

get.summary: List private generations sessions
get.description: Actor-private within one workspace: installation credentials share the installation actor; each operator has an isolated owner. Current workspace Read is required for reads and Write for mutations; API-key inference credentials alone do not authorize these administrator routes. Saved-state reads and all writes never dispatch, refresh or replay inference. Read categories are video (default) and chat; legacy Chat write APIs remain unchanged. Revisions and sequences are decimal strings. Video instructions follow existing Chat/intents JSON storage (not application-encrypted at rest); Video content expires after 30 days and is hidden immediately, then cleared by retention maintenance. Task identity and history remain. Archive does not cancel tasks or remove outputs/billing. Stable descending creation time then UUID pagination; before refers to an actor-visible record independently of its current archive state; archiving a prior page cursor does not invalidate traversal. Invalid cursor returns 400, never an empty page. Limit 1..100; next_before is null when exhausted. Set category=chat for a read-only bridge over the existing actor-private Chat record. The same route defaults to video; IDs are scoped independently by category. Chat metadata uses database clocks and current guarded-write revision. Missing Chat title is null, never replaced by an internal ID. Chat turns preserve comparison branches, not one running conversation task. Per-turn creation/expiry clocks are unknown and null; missing retained prompt yields missing state and null instruction. Turn references are read-only scoped identity/sequence/instruction digests and cannot be used with Video writes. Branch phase/output are exact saved conversation content; actual execution references require a current workspace attempt and matching model. Customer charges are hydrated from the existing ledger projection; no saved procurement fields are returned. Chat retention and writes stay under the legacy Chat contract; Video 30-day instruction retention does not apply to this bridge. This canonical route requires category explicitly: session identity is (workspace, authenticated owner, category, UUID). Chat projection reads remain read-only; guarded Chat mutations use the workspace chats routes. A Chat identifier never authorizes a Video mutation. The server resolves the organization from the authorized workspace. Foreign or missing workspaces return 404. The compatibility route remains supported with identical payload, owner, revision and replay semantics.

Other reasoning options on priced routes are rejected. Model support remains upstream-specific.

content.description: Usually text or null for a function call; extensions remain provider-specific.

arguments.description: JSON-encoded function arguments; Niu does not execute the function.

usage.description: Optional provider token usage. Its presence alone does not guarantee complete valid accounting evidence. Customer charges must be read from billing APIs, never inferred from missing counters.

handler_operations_json_ChatCompletionRe.description: Nonstreaming completion envelope. Provider extension fields may be present. Missing usage is unknown, not zero.

owner_funded.description: Configuration-list metadata identifying a private credential owned by one account. Not accepted in configuration writes.

supplier.description: Provider ownership on configuration-list reads; credentials and commercial data are excluded.

api_base.description: HTTPS endpoint or HTTP loopback endpoint without URL credentials or query parameters.

supplier_id.description: Existing Provider business to own this API-key configuration. Mutually exclusive with create_supplier=true; ownership and creation commit atomically.

create_supplier.description: Atomically create a Provider business with this name and its explicit configuration ownership link. Omission preserves legacy configuration-only creation.

api_key.description: Omit to retain the current credential.

available.description: Configuration eligibility in the management list; not an upstream health or entitlement check.

owner_funded.description: Management-list metadata identifying private owner-funded routes. Omitted from configuration writes.

provider_assets.description: Explicit FastRouter asset protocol on an Ark adapter; not processing readiness or commercial qualification.

supports_generate_content.description: Native GenerateContent opt-in for static or managed gemini routes; does not imply streaming, tools or media support.

supports_messages_streaming_tools.description: Explicit native client-tool SSE capability; requires supports_messages_tools and supports_messages_streaming. JSON arguments are bounded and validated at block completion.

supports_messages_tools.description: Explicit buffered native client-tool capability; requires supports_messages. Streaming tools require the separate supports_messages_streaming_tools capability.

supports_messages_streaming.description: Explicit native text SSE opt-in; requires supports_messages.

supports_messages.description: Explicit native Messages nonstreaming text capability for OpenRouter or Anthropic routes. Does not imply streaming, tools or media support.

handler_operations_json_CatalogMetadata.description: Descriptive provider metadata, stored under capabilities.catalog on vendor mappings and exposed as catalog on model listings. Advertised USD per-token prices are separate from billing rates. Missing values mean unknown, never zero.

handler_operations_json_VideoSchema.description: Versioned constraints for the exact alias/upstream model/channel. The enclosing capabilities document is limited to 16 KiB. Backend validation enforces relative bounds, defaults, input transport, roles and incompatible controls. Configuration does not qualify a route or enable unsupported media/callback transport.

revision.description: Trimmed canonical revision with no control characters; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

model_alias.description: Must match the enclosing model alias.

upstream_model.description: Must match the enclosing upstream mapping.

channel.description: Exact canonical channel contract; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

required_controls.description: Every named control must be configured.

exclusive_controls.description: Each pair names distinct configured controls; both cannot have defaults.

callbacks_qualified.description: Required for a callback_url declaration; separate adapter/offer qualification and callback authentication still apply.

handler_operations_json_VideoInputRule.description: Item/count bounds cannot exceed the enclosing request limits. Non-text inputs require HTTPS or at least one allowed Base64 MIME type; required roles need at least one allowed role. Names are trimmed, control-free and limited to 256 UTF-8 bytes.

api_prompt_rate.description: Currency nanounits per million tokens. JSON integer, not a decimal string. Platform procurement metadata only.

api_completion_rate.description: Currency nanounits per million tokens. JSON integer, not a decimal string. Platform procurement metadata only.

cash_prompt_rate.description: Currency nanounits per million tokens. JSON integer, not a decimal string. Platform procurement metadata only.

cash_completion_rate.description: Currency nanounits per million tokens. JSON integer, not a decimal string. Platform procurement metadata only.

max_input_tokens.description: Operator-attested provider token bound used for pre-dispatch liability admission; not an estimated token count.

max_output_tokens.description: Operator-attested provider token bound used for pre-dispatch liability admission; not an estimated token count.

handler_operations_json_VendorRoutePrici.description: Confidential route procurement configuration, separate from customer selling tariffs. All fields are required when non-null. Combined charges at the configured bounds must fit a signed 64-bit nanounit amount; invalid or overflowing configurations are rejected. Personal-owned credentials require null pricing.

pricing.description: Optional validated route pricing. Personal-owned credentials require null pricing; non-null pricing is rejected at save. Null clears pricing; omission preserves existing pricing on updates and leaves cost unknown on creates.

id.description: Provider model ID used for inference routing.

name.description: Display name supplied by the provider.

requests_30d.description: Request operations created in the last 30 days; retries count once.

requests_by_day.description: UTC daily counts for today and the preceding 29 days, including zero days.

slug.description: Stable, readable workspace slug. Use in dashboard URLs; renaming preserves it.

slug_aliases.description: Previously issued slugs accepted for existing bookmarks.

name.description: Must contain non-whitespace text; at most 200 UTF-8 bytes before trimming. The saved name is trimmed.

organization_id.description: Company scope. Members default to their current company. Installation callers may omit it to create a Personal workspace company.

spending_limit.description: Optional lifetime retail cap in an existing company account currency. Requires an owner or installation administrator. Saved atomically with the workspace; omitted means no limit.

slug.description: Optional unique slug. When omitted, generated from the name using pinyin for Chinese, normalized separators, and a numeric suffix on collisions. The value default is reserved.

handler_operations_json_KeyInput.description: Unknown fields are rejected. Configure per-key customer spending, IP allowlist, rolling request rate, token budgets and concurrent-request limits through their separate key management APIs. Key creation does not set these policies. Workspace and company financial limits still apply; rotation preserves the key lineage policies.

allowed_models.description: Deprecated. Omit to grant every model available to this workspace; explicit aliases are retained for compatibility. The wildcard must be the only entry when used.

ttl_seconds.description: Required. Integer 1 to 31536000 sets a finite lifetime; explicit null creates a key without automatic expiration. Missing, zero or negative values are rejected. Revocation and all lineage limits still apply.

token.description: One-time workspace API key secret; store securely. Never present in key metadata reads.

handler_operations_json_ApiErrorResponse.description: Gateway application error envelope. This does not describe framework body/path parsing failures or a proxy-generated response. Branch on error.type and HTTP status rather than matching message text.

message.description: Safe human-readable explanation; not a stable programmatic identifier.

type.description: Machine-readable failure category; new categories may be added.

code.description: HTTP status code, not a separate application error number.

expires_at_ms.description: Unix milliseconds for finite expiration. Null means no automatic expiration, not an invalid or unknown timestamp. Rotation preserves this state.

last_used_at_ms.description: Latest durable dispatch intent in Unix milliseconds. Null means no attributed dispatch is recorded, not that the credential was never authenticated. Rotation preserves the old key's history; its replacement starts without a dispatch record.

slug.description: Stable readable slug for product URLs. Renaming preserves it.

context_label.description: Meaningful current model/adapter/channel label. Contains no account identifiers.

human_verification.description: Supports explicit private H5 verification operations, not proof of human completion or permission to mutate.

next_cursor.description: Present when limit or after selects paging. Null ends the directory.

handler_operations_json_WorkspaceKeyDeta.description: Workspace management key metadata and customer policies. Never contains the API secret or Provider procurement information.

token_usage_window.description: Null when no snapshot is available; never infer zero usage.

limit_nanos.description: Customer allowance in currency nanounits; null means unlimited.

committed_nanos.description: Customer committed amount in currency nanounits.

remaining_nanos.description: Remaining customer allowance in currency nanounits; null when unlimited.

key.description: Post-write detail snapshot; can be null if the key is removed before this read. The issued secret is still returned only once.

memberCookie.description: Browser member session cookie. Same-origin and CSRF checks still apply to browser writes.
memberCookie.name: __Host-niu_member_session

bearerAuth.description: Bearer credential accepted by this operation. Inference uses a workspace API key; management requires an authorized member session or installation credential. See the operation description for required authority and scope.

niuApiKeyAuth.name: X-Niu-API-Key
niuApiKeyAuth.description: Workspace inference API key sent in X-Niu-API-Key. Does not grant member or platform management authority.

adminBearerAuth.description: Management bearer credential. The operation determines whether installation authority or a scoped member role is required; ordinary inference keys are insufficient.

operatorBearer.description: Member session bearer credential. Provider membership and role are checked per operation; company ownership alone does not grant Provider authority.
